editorial: In today's technology agenda, large language models and infrastructure optimizations are at the forefront. Cloudflare engineers' memory-saving work on DNS cache stands out as the day's most concrete technical achievement regarding system efficiency.

items.title: tt-a1i/archify
items.summary: Archify is an AI agent skill that generates software architecture, workflow, and data flow diagrams as verifiable and interactive HTML files. Used to visualize complex system designs, this tool allows for exporting outputs in high-resolution and editable formats.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: Scientific-agent-skills is a library containing 163 verified skills and over 100 databases that specialize AI agents in scientific research processes. It works compatibly with tools like the Cursor code editor and the Claude Code AI assistant, enabling data-driven analysis in the fields of biology, chemistry, and medicine.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: Anthropic offers an official directory that gathers high-quality plugins developed for Claude Code in a single hub. This resource serves as a standard reference point for developers looking to expand the capabilities of the AI-powered coding tool, Claude Code.

items.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
items.summary: Gods-eye-view is a spatial intelligence simulator that visualizes real-time satellite data on a browser-based 3D globe. Developed with JavaScript, this open-source project allows users to examine live data on Earth through a photorealistic interface.

items.title: abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus
items.summary: GitNexus is a code analysis engine that runs in the browser and transforms code repositories into an interactive knowledge graph. Using local or cloud-based Git repositories, it offers a built-in Graph RAG (Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agent to make sense of the codebase.

items.title: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines
items.summary: go-modern-guidelines, published by JetBrains, is a guide prepared to ensure that AI coding assistants develop software in accordance with current Go standards. This guide aims to produce higher-quality outputs by basing code generation processes on the language's latest features and best practices.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage is an open-source system that transforms AI-based coding assistants into comprehensive video production studios. With twelve different production pipelines and support for hundreds of tools, it offers agent skills that automate video creation processes.

items.title: abi/screenshot-to-code
items.summary: Screenshot-to-code is a software tool that analyzes screenshot files and converts them into clean HTML, Tailwind, React, or Vue code. It allows developers to quickly turn interface designs into working code snippets.

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: The code editor Cursor has released an official plugin specification for developers to create their own plugins. This standard allows users to add custom capabilities to the AI-powered code editor.

items.title: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
items.summary: GPT-Image2 is a prompt engine and template library that structures visual creation processes as code (prompt as code). Through more than 530 reverse-engineered examples and over 20 industrial templates, it enables the development of standard skills in AI image generation.

items.title: tailscale/tailcat
items.summary: Tailcat, developed by Tailscale, is a version of the command-line tool Netcat—used for securely transferring network traffic—that runs on the Tailscale network layer. It enables direct device-to-device data transmission without the need for a control plane.

items.title: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
items.summary: Ghidra, developed by the National Security Agency (NSA), is a comprehensive analysis framework used for software reverse engineering processes. Written in Java, this tool allows security researchers to perform detailed examinations by deciphering the code structure of binary files.

items.title: marin-community/marin
items.summary: Marin is an open-source Python framework designed for the research and development of foundation models. This software aims to standardize the processes of training and optimizing large-scale artificial intelligence models.

items.title: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
items.summary: FreeLLMAPI combines 34 different free large language model providers into a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. With intelligent routing and automatic error handling features, it allows developers to test different models through a single interface.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.summary: Developed for Chrome DevTools, this server allows coding agents to directly access browser tools. Operating via the Model Context Protocol, this tool enables AI-powered systems to automate web development processes.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: This resource, which enables software developers to learn AI engineering processes from the ground up, presents model development and deployment stages with practical examples in Python. By combining theoretical knowledge with hands-on projects, it helps users create and deploy their own AI-based applications.

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.summary: Ponytail is a JavaScript library that teaches AI agents to generate solutions with minimal effort. It offers an approach that aims to achieve results in the most efficient and shortest way by preventing unnecessary code writing in software development processes.

items.title: google/googletest
items.summary: GoogleTest is a framework that allows for writing tests and creating mock objects for C++ projects. It provides a standard testing environment for software developers to detect code errors early.

items.title: livekit/agents
items.summary: LiveKit Agents is a Python framework used to develop real-time voice and video AI agents. This structure, which enables low-latency interactions, provides tools to manage complex processes such as audio processing and video streaming.

items.title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
items.summary: Cloudflare saved 100 terabytes in memory usage by optimizing its 1.1.1.1 Domain Name System (DNS) cache. This improvement aims to reduce server costs by increasing efficiency in data structures.

items.title: "IT WoRKs BeTter in the App "
items.summary: The common belief that mobile applications offer better performance and user experience compared to websites is being questioned through technical constraints and developer preferences. Despite the development of web standards, the fact that some services offer app-specific features to steer users toward native software creates debates over the open nature of the internet.

items.title: Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful, US judge rules
items.summary: A US court found the blacklisting of AI company Anthropic by the Pentagon to be unlawful. This decision redefines the legal boundaries of restrictions on the use of generative AI in defense industry projects.

items.title: Doctors are finally learning to manage antidepressant withdrawal
items.summary: The medical world is reviewing treatment protocols following increasing complaints from patients experiencing antidepressant withdrawal syndrome. Experts are working on new approaches that involve reducing medication dosages more slowly and in a controlled manner.

items.title: Luanti removed from Google Play due to baseless AI copyright notice
items.summary: The open-source game engine Luanti has been removed from the Google Play store due to an artificial intelligence-based false copyright infringement notice. This situation opens up a discussion on the negative impacts of automated content moderation systems on developers and the responsibilities of platforms in this process.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text data. Focused on generating fast responses with low latency, this model analyzes visual content to create text-based outputs.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash, published by Zai-org, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. Aiming to provide fast responses with low latency, this model is receiving high engagement on the Hugging Face platform.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen2.5-27B, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing both visual and text data. It aims to demonstrate high performance in complex tasks by combining advanced language understanding and image analysis capabilities.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3
items.summary: GLM-5.3, developed by Zai, is an artificial intelligence model optimized for text generation tasks. Shared on Hugging Face, this model is used in text creation processes within the large language models category.

items.title: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
items.summary: Unsloth is an optimization library used to train large language models faster and with lower memory usage. This optimized GGUF format version of the Qwen2.5-7B model offers more efficient inference performance compared to standard methods.

items.title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
items.summary: TacForcing is a method that updates motion plans by processing tactile feedback in real-time during robotic manipulation processes. Unlike existing vision-language-action models, it eliminates the need for complex controllers by enabling the system to react according to physical contact conditions that change during action.

items.title: What Does an Evaluation License? A Commit-Bound Census of Claim-Relative Inference in Inspect Evals
items.summary: This study, shared by Hugging Face, examines the verifiability of metrics in evaluation tools (Inspect Evals) that measure the performance of artificial intelligence models. The research reveals that the data and methods used in current testing processes lack the transparency required to reproduce the claimed results.

items.title: EditaLive! Unified Character Video Editing for Live Streaming
items.summary: EditaLive offers a framework that makes human-centric video editing processes real-time in live broadcasts. Unlike existing editing tools, the method maintains facial expression consistency and eliminates the requirement for offline processing.

items.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: PILOT in the Loop allows artificial intelligence agents to improve their performance by using the experiences they gain during long-term tasks in real-time. Unlike traditional models, this method allows agents to correct their errors by applying learned information during the ongoing work process rather than after the task is finished.

items.title: Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models
items.summary: Instead of traditional video data used to train world models, it is proposed to use verifiable data trajectories created in game development environments. It is argued that, similar to AI agents that write code, executable game environments provide high-quality reward signals for reinforcement learning.

items.title: EasyEffects should be part of every Linux distribution to improve laptop speaker sound quality
items.summary: EasyEffects is an audio effects tool that processes audio signals and improves speaker quality on Linux systems. It is suggested that this software be included as a standard in all Linux distributions to balance low hardware performance on laptops.

items.title: OpenOffice does not print on Tuesdays (2009)
items.summary: A printing error encountered in a specific version of the open-source office software OpenOffice was caused by a logic bug that resulted in the software not working only on Tuesdays. This situation demonstrates that bugs in complex codebases can emerge due to conditions that appear unexpected and coincidental.

items.title: Quest for eternal dock on Wayland - lambdock (C + GTK4 + Lisp GNU Guile Scheme)
items.summary: Lambdock is an open-source tool that aims to provide a persistent application launcher on the Wayland display server. Developed using C, the GTK4 interface library, and the GNU Guile Scheme programming language, this project provides a customizable taskbar experience in desktop environments.

glossary.explanation: The specific capability an AI software possesses to perform a particular task.
The set of skills a software or system acquires to perform specific operations.
Small pieces of software added to a main program later to provide it with new features.
The ability of computers to perceive and interpret the position and movement of objects in the physical world.
A data structure that presents the relationships between pieces of information by connecting them like a network map.
A method used by artificial intelligence to reach more accurate information by using the relationships between interconnected data while generating answers.
Accepted methods that yield the most efficient and error-free results when performing a task.
A sequence of automated processes that software goes through from development and testing until it is presented to the actual user.
Various specialized skills used by AI assistants to complete complex tasks.
Short and ready-to-use code snippets used to quickly add necessary functions while programming.
Technical rules and standards that a plugin must follow to work compatibly with the main program.
Versioning and managing prompts given to artificial intelligence as if they were software code.
A central management layer that governs how a system operates and controls traffic and settings.
An American government agency that collects intelligence for national security by monitoring internet and communication networks.
The process of reverse-engineering the code or structure of ready-made software to understand how it works.
Massive artificial intelligence models trained on very large datasets that serve as the foundation for many different tasks such as text generation or image creation.
